summary: Both issues from the prior spec review are resolved. (1) PHASE2_PROFIT_FACTOR_FLOOR is now a true alias referencing PHASE2_PROFIT_FACTOR_FLOOR_ADMISSION (not hardcoded 1.15), and the alias is defined AFTER the ADMISSION flag it references (line 613 vs 608). (2) The test now uses the exact spec scenario: pf=1.10, compares EVOLUTION=1.05 (new) vs EVOLUTION=1.15 (old admission floor), and asserts the new floor produces a strictly smaller penalty. The fix commit touches only config.py and test_phase2_rule_pool.py (17 insertions + 17 deletions). All 304 related tests pass (162 + 30 + 10 + 16 + 45 + 41). No other changes. Implementation satisfies all 8 acceptance criteria from the spec.
